args.brief: Chapter 3: The Duplicate. Pema reads the handling note, then asks Eli for the missing second page of the tide register. The duplicate page arrives wet (damp from a leaking carry tube or rain on the walk over). Pema dries it flat — blotting paper, weighted boards, even pressure, no heat that would cock or warp the paper — checking it only when flat and dry. Cal disagrees about whether to wait for full drying before citing the figure; Pema holds the practical line. The wax packet stays sealed and intact throughout. No one is hurt. Ends with the team agreeing to complete the check before the demonstration, with the dried duplicate readable and a definite question about the transposed line. Third person past, close on Pema, quiet precise tone.
